unique_value: query IDs are one-shot identities bound to purpose, unique columns and SQL digest
attempted query-ID rebinding to a different intent fails closed while exact re-registration is idempotent
purpose-to-downstream-use policy has a deterministic fingerprint
column escalation and purpose mismatch refuse before downstream reuse is allowed
registration/use events bind query-intent fingerprint, policy fingerprint, verdict, reason and previous-event fingerprint
ledger fingerprint binds current immutable intents, policy identity and chained event history
does_not_own: semantic entailment between query result and claim

capability_contribution.ownership: Canonical Snowflake-lens specialist for immutable query intent registration and purpose-bound downstream reuse governance.

relationships.boundary: claim citation fencing is separate from query-purpose/downstream-use authorization

next_evolution: Persist immutable intent/event receipts in a durable store, bind authenticated actor/authority and result identity, then expose full intent fingerprints to the claim fence through executable receipt-level integration.
nonclaims: no SQL execution or query-result verification
no external identity authentication or Snowflake RLS enforcement
